class.name: ResourceSaveResult
class.brief_description: The result of a resource save: the error code and the saver's message.

members.member: [constant OK] if the save succeeded. Otherwise the code of the saver, for example [constant ERR_CANT_CREATE] or [constant ERR_FILE_CANT_WRITE] for a path that cannot be written, [constant ERR_FILE_UNRECOGNIZED] if no saver handles the resource or the extension, or [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] for a [code]null[/code] resource or an empty path.

Empty if the save succeeded. Otherwise the errors printed while saving, one per line and oldest first (at most 16 lines). If nothing was printed, it is the name of [member error] followed by the path.
[code]true[/code] if the save succeeded; the same as [code]error == OK[/code].
The path the resource was saved to: the path given to [method ResourceSaver.save_result], or [member Resource.resource_path] if that was empty.
